doc.brief: The QButtonGroup class provides a container to organize groups of button widgets.
doc.index_brief: Container to organize groups of button widgets

QAbstractButton * button(int id) const.brief: Returns the button with the specified *id*, or `nullptr` if no such button exists.

QAbstractButton * checkedButton() const.brief: Returns the button group's checked button, or `nullptr` if no buttons are checked.

QButtonGroup(QObject *parent).brief: Constructs a new, empty button group with the given *parent*.

QList<QAbstractButton *> buttons() const.brief: Returns the button group's list of buttons.

bool exclusive() const.brief: This property holds whether the button group is exclusive

int checkedId() const.brief: Returns the id of the [checkedButton](xref:qt:QButtonGroup)(), or -1 if no button is checked.

int id(QAbstractButton *button) const.brief: Returns the id for the specified *button*, or -1 if no such button exists.

void addButton(QAbstractButton *button,.brief: Adds the given *button* to the button group.

void buttonClicked(QAbstractButton *butt.brief: This signal is emitted when the given *button* is clicked.

void buttonPressed(QAbstractButton *butt.brief: This signal is emitted when the given *button* is pressed down.

void buttonReleased(QAbstractButton *but.brief: This signal is emitted when the given *button* is released.

void buttonToggled(QAbstractButton *butt.brief: This signal is emitted when the given *button* is toggled. *checked* is true if the button is checked, or false if the button is unchecked.

void idClicked(int id).brief: This signal is emitted when a button with the given *id* is clicked.

void idPressed(int id).brief: This signal is emitted when a button with the given *id* is pressed down.

void idReleased(int id).brief: This signal is emitted when a button with the given *id* is released.

void idToggled(int id, bool checked).brief: This signal is emitted when a button with the given *id* is toggled. *checked* is true if the button is checked, or false if the button is unchecked.

void removeButton(QAbstractButton *butto.brief: Removes the given *button* from the button group.

void setExclusive(bool).brief: This property holds whether the button group is exclusive

exclusive.brief: Whether the button group is exclusive
